cards.definition: To make a message or object go to someone.
cards.example:
- I send the report every Friday before six.
Envio o relatório toda sexta antes das seis.
cards.note: Passado irregular: sent. Send someone something ou send something TO someone.

cards.definition: To get something that someone sent you.
cards.example:
- Did you receive my email from Tuesday?
Você recebeu meu e-mail de terça?
cards.note: Grafia: rec-EI-ve. O substantivo receipt (recibo) tem o P mudo.

cards.definition: To send a message you received on to another person.
cards.example:
- I'll forward you the client's message right now.
Vou te encaminhar a mensagem do cliente agora.
cards.note: Botão “Fw”. Também: look forward to (aguardar com expectativa).

cards.definition: A polite word used to end an email before your name.
cards.example:
- Best regards, Paula Lima — Sales team.
Atenciosamente, Paula Lima — equipe de Vendas.
cards.note: Best regards (padrão), Kind regards (britânico), Regards (mais seco).

cards.example:
- This is not urgent — you can answer tomorrow.
Isso não é urgente — você pode responder amanhã.
cards.note: Dizer o que NÃO é urgente é um dos hábitos mais elegantes do e-mail.

cards.definition: To say clearly that something is true or agreed.
cards.example:
- Could you confirm you received the invoice?
Você poderia confirmar que recebeu a nota fiscal?
cards.note: Confirm receipt = confirmar o recebimento — muito usado em compras.

cards.definition: A phrase used to open an email and say why you are writing.
cards.example:
- I'm writing to ask about the delivery date.
Estou escrevendo para perguntar sobre a data de entrega.
cards.note: Abre o e-mail dizendo o motivo na primeira linha. Direto e educado.

cards.definition: Used to ask someone to tell you their answer.
cards.example:
- Let me know if Thursday works for you.
Me avise se quinta funcionar para você.
cards.note: Fechamento amigável e curto. Formal: Please let me know.

cards.definition: To add a file to an email.
cards.example:
- I'm attaching the contract in PDF — please check page two.
Estou anexando o contrato em PDF — confira a página dois, por favor.
cards.note: Substantivo: attachment (anexo). Não confunda com attack (atacar).

cards.definition: To see or realise something; also a written announcement.
cards.example:
- I didn't notice your email — it went to the spam folder.
Não percebi seu e-mail — ele foi para a pasta de spam.
cards.note: “Notícia” é news: good news = boa notícia.

questions.prompt: I _____ the report every Friday before six.
questions.explanation: “Send something to someone”, or “send someone something”.

questions.prompt: Você recebeu meu e-mail de terça?
questions.answer: Did you receive my email from Tuesday?|Did you receive my email on Tuesday?
questions.explanation: “Receive” is to get what someone sent.

questions.prompt: I'll _____ you the client's message right now.
questions.explanation: “Forward” passes a message you received to someone else.

questions.prompt: How do you close a work email in English?
questions.explanation: “Atenciosamente” translated word for word gives “attentiously”, which is not English.

questions.prompt: This is not _____ — you can answer tomorrow.
Você poderia confirmar que recebeu a fatura?
questions.answer: Could you confirm you received the invoice?|Could you confirm that you received the invoice?

questions.explanation: A standard email opener: “I'm writing to” + verb.
“Let me know” asks for an answer later.

questions.prompt: The contract goes with the email. You…
questions.explanation: In English you “attach” a file; “in attachment” is the Portuguese “em anexo”.

questions.prompt: Your colleague's email went to spam and you never saw it. You say:
options: I didn't notice of your email.
questions.explanation: “Notice” takes the object directly, with no preposition.
